book.commonName: Saveeŋ To Ipaghazoŋan Ŋgar Yoŋgaaŋ To Maaron
book.title: Saveeŋ To Ipaghazoŋan Ŋgar Yoŋgaaŋ To Maaron Kamapim Tok Hait—Revelation

content: Tipait Maaron izi ndug sambam
Muri ghoro, nalooŋ oroor tiina ivot izi ndug sambam inimale ival tiina kat timbou. Tighaze:

content.text: “Aleluia, tapait Tiina toit Maaron! Ye igham mulin ghiit ve taneep poia wa. Ye iza tiina. Ve tapiri paam, tiina le tiina kat. Syg 7:10,12
Ighaze ye iŋgabiiz tamtoghon ve ighur atia padi, gabizooŋ toni, nene deŋia ve onoon moghon.
Liva to ataam to iza tiina, ye igheghereb tamtoghon to taan pa ŋgar toni samsamia, ve yesŋa tighurghur maat. Tauto Maaron ighur atia pani.
Muuŋ, liva tonowen irabrab mbesooŋa to Maaron ve siŋ todi imamaliŋ. Tauto aazne, Maaron iyat ŋgar toni tonowen.” Syg 15:3, 16:7

content: Ghoro ival tiina tonowen timboob muul tighaze: “Aleluia! Yab to ighan liva samia tonowen, mbuasa pale izaza tovene itaghoni taghoni gha ila.” Syg 18:9,18
Ghoro ŋginiiŋa tamoot ee ve paaŋ (24), toman mbeb matadi yaryaara paaŋ, titap tizi ve tipait Maaron to ineep ila ina to ghamuuŋ pooz ne iza tighaze: “Aleluia! Onoon kat. Iit tapait Maaron iza!”

Ghoro saveeŋ ivot ila Maaron ina to ghamuuŋ pooz ve inim ighaze: “Yam mbesooŋa to Maaron to amatughez pani ve ataghon ŋgar toni, asob apait Maaron toit iza! Yam to izamim tintina, ve yam to lemim izamim maau ne paam.” Mbo 22:23; Syg 11:18

Mala maau ve nalooŋ oroor tiina ivot izi sambam muul. Oroor tonowen, inimale ival tiina timboboob. Ve inimale ndug to ya katindi tiyatyaat tizi pani, ve inimale lalaav kiliŋia. Ival tiina tonowen tisaav tighaze:

content.text: “Aleluia! Iit tapait Tiina toit Maaron iza. Ye tapiri tiina kat. Ilib pa mbeb to naol ne. Ve ighamgham pooz irau sawa isob. Mbo 93:1; Syg 11:17

Iit tiniid iza ve lolood poia, ve tapait iza pa tapiri ve poia toni. Pasa, Sipsip to Maaron vaiuuŋ toni, tauto ighaze ivot tonene. Liva to tisia pani, ye igharaat tau wa. Mt 22:2; 2Kor 11:2; Ep 5:32; Syg 21:2,9
Ye indudi pa nonogiiŋa pisosooŋa to Maaron tau igham pani. Nonogiiŋa tonowen, iŋgalaaŋ ve milmilia kat.”

content: (Nonogiiŋa tonenen iza to ŋgar deŋiadi naol to Maaron tamtoghon toni patabuaŋa tighamgham di.) Is 61:10; Syg 3:5

Ghoro aŋela isaav payou muul ighaze: “Umbood saveeŋ tovene: ‘Yes to tipoi di tinim pa Sipsip to Maaron vaiuuŋ toni, ve yesŋa tilup di pa ghanghaniiŋ, nene pale tinidi iza pa poia to Maaron to iza todi.’” Ve ipariaaŋ saveeŋ toni ighaze: “Saveeŋ tonene, nene saveeŋ onoon to Maaron.” Lu 14:15+

Ye isaav tovene, ve natap nazi aghe pughu naghaze napaiti. Eemoghon ye iŋgalsekin ghou ighaze: “Wai, ugham vene malep! You mbesooŋa to Maaron nanimale yom ve yes toŋvetaz tiom to yamŋa akis saveeŋ onoon to Yesu ariaŋa, ve apariaaŋ tamtoghon pa tighur ila toni. Tovenen uput aghem ve upait Maaron moghon. Pasa, uraat tau to yes propeta, nene vene: Yes tipariaaŋ tamtoghon, leso tighur ila to Yesu.”
Malmal tiina to Mboŋ Muri

Ghoro matag ila le naghita sambam ikaak. Ve naghita hos pisosooŋa eez, ve ŋgeu eez ineep izala pogho. Ŋgeu tonowen, tiwaata tighaze: ‘Ŋgeu to ighamgham ŋgar onoon, ve itaghon saveeŋ mbuaaŋ toni.’ Sawa to iŋgabiiz tamtoghon ve ighur atia padi, ma igham malmal, ye itataghon ŋgar deŋia moghon. Mbo 45:3+, 96:13; Syg 1:5, 6:2

Mata inimale yab yama. Ve moghar katindi to kinik tineep ila daba. Ve timbood iza ila tini pataghaaŋ wa. Iza tonowen, tamtoghon ite paam iwatag pughu maau. Ye moghon to iwatagi. Dan 10:6; Syg 1:14, 2:18
Nonogiiŋa toni, siŋ ikaria le isami. Ve tiwaat iza tovene: ‘Ŋgeu to ipaghazoŋan ghiit pa saveeŋ ve ŋgar to Maaron.’ Is 63:2+; Yo 1:1,14
Ye imuuŋ, ve ndaaba katindi to sambam titaghoni. Yes tineep izala hos pisosooŋadi poghodi, ve nonogiiŋa todi pisosooŋa ve ŋgalaŋadi kat.

Ŋgeu to imuuŋ padi, buza eez to mata kat ineep ila avo. Leso imbut tamtoghon to ndug ndug pani. Ve ye pale iŋgin di ve igham pooz padi. Ve pooz toni, nene ariaŋa kat. Tovenen ye pale ivazag di ila aghe samba, ve siŋ todi ireer inimale vaen to tivazagi ve suru izi. Leso ipatooŋ mbalmbali to Maaron padi. Ye Maaron ariaŋa to igham pooz pa mbeb to naol ne. Syg 1:16, 12:5, 14:19+
Ŋgeu tonenen, timbood iza ila nonogiiŋa toni ve ila ŋgoi paam tovene: ‘Kinik To Ilib pa Kinik Tisob, ve Maaron Tiina To Ilib Pa Ndimaronŋa Tisob.’ 1Tim 6:15; Syg 17:14
Ghoro naghita aŋela eez iyoon ila ndag lolo, ve imboob ila pa man tisob to tirovroov ila tata paroŋania ighaze: “Yam anim alup gham pa ghanghaniiŋ tiina to Maaron! Ezek 39:17+

Leso aghan tamtoghon tisob to taan mindadi. Yes kinik, yes daba to malmal, yes to tapiridi tintina, hos toman yes to tilaan padi, yes mbesooŋa, yes to mbesooŋa maau ve tiŋgin taudi, yes to izadi tintina, ve yes to ledi izadi maau ne paam. Aghan di tisob.”
Ghoro naghita mbeb samia ve yes kinik to taan toman ndaaba todi tila tilup di tighaze tigham malmal pa ŋgeu to ineep izala hos pisosooŋa pogho, toman ndaaba toni. Mbo 2:2; Syg 16:14+, 17:12+

Eemoghon tapiridi iraua maau. Mbeb samia tonenen, yesuru ita ite to propet kaarom, ŋgeu tonowen toman ndaaba toni tigham di, ve tipiyaav di matadi iyaryaar ve tizila saambu tiina to ivon pa yaam salfa ve yab to ighanghan irau sawa isob. Propet kaarom tonowen, muuŋ igham mbeb samia nagho, ve ighamgham mbeb gharatooŋadi ila tamtoghon matadi. Tauto itombaan di ve tigham ghilalooŋ to mbeb samia, ve tiput aghedi pa mbeb tonowen anunu. Dan 7:11; Syg 13:13+, 20:10

Mbeb ru tonowen ndaaba todi paam, ŋgeu to ineep izala hos pisosooŋa pogho, imbut di pa buza to ineep ila avo, le tisob timatmaat. Ghoro man tisob tiroov tila, ve timbutur izala poghodi, ve tighan tighan le apodi isuŋ.
